newsitem.title: USA: CapStar five million share offer priced.
newsitem.headline: CapStar five million share offer priced.

text.p: CapStar Hotel Co said its 5,000,000 share public offering of common stock was priced at $24.75 per share.
The offering was managed by Lehman Brothers, BT Securities, Goldman Sachs, Merrill Lynch, Montgomery Securities and Smith Barney.

The underwriters have an over-allotment option to buy up to an additional 750,000 shares. Net proceeds from the offering will be used to fund the cash portion of the purchase price of the company's acquisition of eight hotels and to retire outstanding balances under its credit facility and for general corporate purposes.
